FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Okanagan Crossing Pipelines Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Field operator
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Heads up. Found a lube oil leak at Jarvie station around 3:30 pm today. Small spot on the west
side near the mainline pump. Looks like erosion under the pad-ground gave way, pipe sagged,
fitting sheared off. About 1.8 m³ on the gravel. Contained inside fence, berm held it. Shut pump,
isolated the line, started soaking up with pads. Called in spill kit, supervisor notified. Will keep
mopping up. No other issues seen.
-M. Chen, field op
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
